decisions: the live execution path runs through queue, admission, dispatch and service
no second production path may reach an executor
orch:run is an adapter or a development-only path, never a production bypass
CLIENT opened to controlled live execution
DEBTOR opened to controlled live execution
RECEIVABLE opened to controlled live execution
UYAP_CONNECTOR opened to controlled live execution for technical work only
OFFICE and COLLECTION keep their existing eligibility and grants
each program receives its own standing grant
no single unbounded grant covers several programs
eligibility opens a lane, never a mandate over units the program denied
UYAP production external activation remains a separate owner decision
no per-child-task owner ratification is required inside these bounds
orchestration-owned PRs auto-squash-merge once every merge gate holds
validity: until program completion, explicit owner revocation, kill switch, or scope violation
nonTransferable: not to another program, repository or owner workstream
